concerns.text: FR-001 specifies the computation range as "1 ≤ n ≤ [deferred]". The placeholder [deferred] leaves the upper bound undefined, so no test can be constructed to verify that the algorithm respects memory limits or produces the expected number of rows.

FR-003 requires handling of cases where p_P(n)=0 or Q_as(n)≤0 but does not define the exact behavior (e.g., skip, assign a sentinel, clamp). Without a concrete rule the residual R(n) cannot be deterministically verified.
SC-003 references verification against a "reference_data.csv" file that is not present in the repository, making the claim of exact match for n≤100 untestable.
Multiple acceptance scenarios (e.g., "output CSV contains [deferred] rows") use the [deferred] placeholder instead of a concrete row count, preventing an independent test from being written.

The edge‑case description in the "Edge Cases" section mentions setting the residual to a "specific marker" but does not name the marker or its type, leaving the test harness without a verifiable expected value.

SC-005 requires applying a Bonferroni or Benjamini‑Hochberg correction but does not mandate which method to use; the lack of a deterministic choice makes reproducibility of the p‑value adjustment ambiguous.
